Ancient Tomb.description: A silent chamber of white stone. In the center lies the golden sarcophagus where Golden Bat slept for 10,000 years, its lid cracked in two upon the floor.

secrets.text: You walk to the back of the tomb and see a small crack in the wall, leading north to some secret room...

extra.text: [marie3]Marie sits beside it, her father's waterlogged notes spread across her lap...
The tomb is empty now. Marie has gone below with Professor Yamatone.

Echoing Gallery.description:
The room is filled with ancient wooden frames.
Instead of statues, you see a series of painted boards depicting a golden figure saving children from monsters.
A faint smell of candy fills the air — a memory of the sweets sold to children before the show began.
A plaque reads: 'Before the screen, there was the paper. Before the comic, there was the street...'

Secret Tunnel.description: A narrow, damp passageway lit by faint bioluminescent moss. Fresh bootprints in the mud lead toward the tomb...

Shipwrecked Beach.description: White sands littered with the wreckage of Professor Mire's ship. The Pacific waves crash against jagged rocks, and gulls pick at what the sea has left behind...

extra.text: Giant trenches scar the sand where Five Finger dragged itself back into the sea.

Ocean-Facing Cliffs.description: High, windswept precipices overlooking the vast ocean. From here, you can see the faint glimmer of the lost city below...

extra.text: Something red flutters on a ledge far below.

secrets.text: Far below, on a ledge battered by spray, a crimson cape is snagged on the rocks. No hand could reach it... but perhaps the wind could.

interactions.text: You raise the Kinesis Stone. The wind obeys. A howling updraft tears the crimson cape from the rocks and lays it at your feet.

Abandoned Residential District.description: Crumbling stone houses that once housed the people of Atlantis. Vines choke the ancient architecture, and lanterns still hang in the doorways, unlit for ten thousand years...

Rusted Armory.description: A chamber filled with decayed bronze weapons and empty racks that once held the military might of a lost empire. A towering bronze sentinel stands at the far wall, spear in hand...

Abandoned Church.description: A towering structure with vaulted ceilings. Ancient symbols are carved into the stone, and a cold draft rises from the stairs leading down...

Church Cellar.description: A dark, cramped basement filled with crates of old scrolls and strange, humming minerals. Fresh drill holes pock the walls. Something has been digging...

Ancient Atlantean Lab.description: A massive hall filled with advanced machinery and glowing crystalline computers from a forgotten science. Nazō's men have bolted crude cables into the ancient consoles...

South.blocked_text: The floor to the south has collapsed into a black chasm. The far side is too distant to leap... but something might fly across.
South.pass_text: The Red Cape snaps open like the wings of a great bat, and you glide across the chasm.

East.blocked_text: A wall of crackling spectral energy seals the eastern hall. Somewhere behind it, a man is laughing.

Submerged Observation Deck.description: A glass-domed room beneath the waves. You can see the aquatic life of Atlantis swimming past the reinforced glass...

extra.text: Something vast moves in the deep, just beyond sight. You are not yet ready to face it.
The glass floor lies shattered. A spiral stair of crystal winds down through the cracks, toward the lights of a drowned city.

Sunken Stair.description: A spiral stair of living crystal winds down from the shattered deck into an enormous bubble of air. Below, a city of domes and towers glows with ten thousand drowned lanterns. Fish drift past the walls of the bubble like birds outside a window...

Bell Landing.description: A domed plaza where the air smells of salt and engine oil. Yamatone's Flying Super Car sits in a puddle of seawater, its wheels folded into fins and its headlights glowing. Marie has spread her father's notes across the hood.

Drowned Avenue.description: The great avenue of the sunken city. Seawater laps at your ankles. Statues of the Golden Judge line both sides of the street, their faces worn smooth by ten thousand years of tides. Street lamps flicker along the way... most of them.

extra.text: To the north, a wall of solid crystal seals the archive doors.
To the east, a collapsed arch has buried the market entrance in rubble.

North.blocked_text: A wall of crystal, harder than steel, seals the archive. You can see shapes moving inside.

East.blocked_text: Tons of fallen stone block the market entrance. No arm could move it... but not every force is an arm.

interactions.text: You raise the Silver Baton. A beam of silver light strikes the crystal wall, and it rings like a struck bell... then shatters into glittering dust. The archive is open.
You hold the Kinesis Stone toward the rubble. The ground groans. Block by block, the fallen arch lifts itself aside and settles against the wall.

Spirit Archive.description: A circular library where crystal tablets float in the air like slow snowflakes, each one glowing with Atlantean script. In the center, an old man of pale light drifts with his eyes closed.

extra.text: The old spirit is asleep, trapped in a dream ten thousand years long. Perhaps water could wake him.
The Archivist hovers among his tablets, awake and humming to himself.

beats: You tip the Hydroflask. A single drop falls on the old spirit's brow.
His eyes open. They are full of starlight.
ARCHIVIST: 'Ah... the Judge. I dreamed you would come. I dreamed it for a very long time.'
ARCHIVIST: 'Talk with me, Judge, when you have a moment. An archivist always has something to say.'

Coral Market.description: Rows of stone market stalls, overgrown with coral in every color. Baskets of petrified fruit still sit on the counters. At the back, the ghost of a merchant sleeps slumped over her scales.

extra.text: The merchant's spirit stirs in her sleep, murmuring prices in a dead language.
The merchant's stall is empty. Only a faint scent of spice remains.

beats: You tip the Hydroflask over the sleeping merchant.
She wakes with a start, and laughs, a bright sound in the silent market.
MERCHANT: 'A customer! After all this time! For the Judge, no charge. Take what you need from the stall.'
She fades, still laughing, into the coral. A jar of salve remains on her counter.

Tide Temple.description: A temple of blue stone, half-flooded with warm water. Pillars carved like waves hold up the ceiling. To the north, scalding steam roars from vents in the floor, hiding an inner door.

North.blocked_text: The steam is hot enough to strip flesh. You have none to lose, but even bone would crack in that heat. You would need armor.
North.pass_text: The Swashbuckler Armor glows red, then gold, as you march through the scalding steam unharmed.

Inner Sanctum.description: A small round chamber, eerily quiet after the roar of the vents. An altar of white coral stands in the center. On it rests a crystal flask... and beside it, an empty cradle shaped for a great round lens. Fresh rubber bootprints lead away from it.

Hall of Champions.description: A long hall lined with empty alcoves, each one made to hold a bronze warrior. Only one alcove at the far end was ever filled. To the north, the floor ends at the edge of a black abyss.

extra.text: A faint ghost sleeps inside the champion's empty alcove: the warrior who once wore the armor.
The champion's alcove is empty, and at peace.

North.blocked_text: The abyss drops away into darkness. Far across it, you can see the lights of great pens and Nazō's floodlights.
North.pass_text: The Red Cape spreads wide, and you sail across the abyss on a warm updraft.

beats: You pour a drop of living water into the empty alcove.
The ghost of a young soldier wakes, and looks down at the armor you wear.
SOLDIER: 'It suits you better than it ever suited me, Judge. I was so afraid, the day the sea came.'
[gold]GOLDEN BAT: 'Fear is no shame, soldier. You stood your post. Rest now.'
The soldier salutes, and is gone.

Abyssal Stables.description: Vast pens carved into the cliff face, each big enough to hold a ship. In them sleep the war-machines of Atlantis: bronze rays, iron whales, crystal eels, all dark. Nazō's floodlights and cables are everywhere. To the east, a bronze manta-machine floats at the edge of the harbor channel, waiting for a rider.

East.blocked_text: The harbor channel is far too deep and wide to cross. The bronze manta stirs as you approach, but you have no way to command it.
East.pass_text: You cast the Spectral Reins over the bronze manta. Its eyes light up. It carries you across the channel like a great metal bird.

Drowned Harbor.description: The harbor of the sunken city, a black lagoon beneath the great dome. Gorgo's flagship, a rusted submarine with Nazō's insignia on its tower, is moored at the old stone docks.

extra.text: The Leviathan lies peacefully on the harbor floor. Gorgo's submarine is gone.
